comparison.objective: Twist an ice tray with opposing torques, then invert it to release cubes; candidate locks a gripper stop.
comparison.physical_skill: Bimanual deformation through opposite end torques and controlled dumping versus concentric screw/nut countertorque and tool withdrawal.
comparison.success_condition: Cubes freed and deposited with tray restored versus angular setting retained after tightening and repeated actuation.
comparison.reason: Opposing torque is shared, but one tests tray flexure and release while the other tests locknut-induced setting preservation.
